snippet.title: Hope in the City - World Premiere Official Trailer - FGS Live From Los Angeles
snippet.description:
The world premiere cinematic trailer of Hope in the City, featuring voicover by Angela Tran, which gives us our first ever look at this upcoming, neo-noir mystery game coming to Steam. Release date is to be confirmed, but you can Wishlist and follow the game now on Steam, and join the Discord for updates and gameplay reveals.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #hopeinthecity

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
